description: This is a CMake script used to locate and configure the libpsl library within the build system. It searches for required header and library files, extracts version information, and sets relevant cache variables for downstream build steps.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Searches for the specified header file 'libpsl.h' in system include paths.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Locates the libpsl library file by name.

methods.name: file
methods.description: Reads the contents of the header file to extract the version string.

methods.name: string
methods.description: Performs regex-based string replacement to extract the version number.

methods.name: include
methods.description: Includes additional CMake modules, such as 'FindPackageHandleStandardArgs'.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Handles standard logic for package detection and validation.

calls: find_package_handle_standard_args(LibPSL REQUIRED_VARS LIBPSL_LIBRARY LIBPSL_INCLUDE_DIR VERSION_VAR LIBPSL_VERSION)
